parameters.name: CallbackProvisioningConfig
parameters.description: The application event callback synchronization configuration. This parameter is required when ProvisionProtocolType is set to idaas\_callback.

parameters.name: ProvisionPassword
parameters.description:
Specifies whether IDaaS user event callbacks synchronize passwords. Valid values:
- true: Passwords are synchronized.
- false: Passwords are not synchronized.

parameters.name: ProvisionProtocolType
parameters.description:
The account synchronization protocol type. Valid values:
- idaas\_callback: IDaaS custom event callback-based account synchronization.
- scim2: System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol-based synchronization.

parameters.name: ScimProvisioningConfig
parameters.description: The IDaaS System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol synchronization configuration parameters. This parameter is required when ProvisionProtocolType is set to scim2.
